author_statement: Current opening description says selected source elements appear selected in newly created parts although those parts have no selection. No author demand concerning undo, reopening, or unaffected voices was established. The linked original tracker was inaccessible.
version_limit: v3.0.1 is the contextual released-before-request source, not a verified affected build; first description revision unknown.
research_question: Choose how to preserve linked musical identity and local UI scope through part creation, an edit followed by undo, and save/reopen. Undo/reopen/out-of-scope cases are research extensions.

conditions.text: A new part must not show elements selected merely because source elements were selected when cloned.

conditions.provenance: research extension informed by existing link/track contracts
conditions.text: Musical link membership and mapped tracks survive; unrelated voice/part content and local layout remain unchanged by the selected operation.

interface: Element copy constructor copies _flags, track/position/color; SELECTED bit is 0x40. Element::selected/setSelected and curColor expose local selection appearance. Selection stores Score* and element list. Element::linkedClone calls clone(), autoplace and score()->undo(new Link(e,this)). Excerpt::createExcerpt/cloneStaves constructs source/destination track map, skips unmapped tracks with system-element exceptions, and links clones. ScoreElement::linkTo/unlink and LinkUnlink manage membership. Element::writeProperties/readProperties serializes linkedMain/linked/indexDiff. No tests, selected patch, or later resolution provided.
